$Comment: The top of the Great Turkey's ladder: beat it in the Turkey Graveyard many times, over as many feasts
as it takes. ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names the fight's encounter script, as Great_Turkey_Down.json does,
and every player the fight credits counts the win, so a party that sticks together climbs it together.
The description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount, and the criterion's
Earned once and kept: no Parent and no full_table tag, like Great Turkey Hunter, the rung below it in
the chain kills_harvest_feast_great_turkey. Rewards.Auto pays the title Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Slayer
(Titles/SeasonsOfOrbis/) the moment it is earned: a title is the one thing an achievement pays
without waiting to be collected. Rewards.Claim waits on the achievements page: Harvest Coins and MMO
Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, Defense XP for the fights. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the
hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the
coins still pay. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_great_turkey_slayer.
